tools.name: find_brokers
tools.description: Filter BrokerFlat's 11 partner forex/CFD brokers by platform (MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView), maximum minimum deposit, country of residence, regulator and features (Expert Advisors, swap-free/Islamic, scalping, linking an existing account). Returns each broker's cashback rate, deposit, platforms and regulation.

max_min_deposit_usd.description: Only brokers whose minimum deposit is at or below this amount in USD

country.description: Trader's country of residence in English, e.g. 'United Arab Emirates'

regulator.description: e.g. FCA, CySEC, FSCA, FSA Seychelles

needs_existing_account_linking.description: Trader already has an account and wants cashback on it

tools.name: get_broker
tools.description: Full BrokerFlat data for one broker: account types with spreads and commissions, cashback rates per account and instrument group, regulation with licence numbers, platforms, restricted countries, how to link an existing account.

broker_id.description: e.g. roboforex, fxpro, litefinance, xm, fibo-group, hf-markets, exness, tickmill, windsor-brokers, vantage, orbex

tools.name: calculate_cashback
tools.description: Estimate monthly and yearly cashback in USD for a trading volume (lots per month per instrument group: forex, gold, indices, energies, crypto). Without broker_id it compares all partner brokers and account tiers, highest first.

country.description: Excludes brokers not available in this country

tools.name: get_signup
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions to get cashback with a broker through BrokerFlat (new or existing account), the cashback conditions that apply, and the links: BrokerFlat sign-up, the broker page on brokerflat.com and the broker partner link. Show the steps and conditions together with the link.

has_existing_account.description: True if the trader already has an account with this broker
